claim: Among well-formed quasismooth six-variable loop hypersurfaces \(X_f\subset\mathbb P(a_0,\ldots,a_5)\) with exponents \(b_i\ge2\), positive primitive ambient weights, determinant degree \(d=|\det B|=\prod_{i=0}^{5}b_i-1\), and ample canonical class (equivalently \(d>\sum_{i=0}^{5}a_i\)), the least possible weighted degree is \(d=17279\). It is attained by \(f=x_0^4x_1+x_1^6x_2+x_2^5x_3+x_3^6x_4+x_4^6x_5+x_5^4x_0\) with weights \((3723,2387,2957,2494,2315,3389)\); this hypersurface is rational and has ample canonical \(\mathbb Q\)-Cartier class \(K_X\sim_{\mathbb Q}14H\). This minimum is only for the stated single-loop determinant class, not for all rational weighted hypersurfaces.

limitations: Not a minimum over all Delsarte polynomials, chains, sums of loops, other rationality constructions, or all rational weighted hypersurfaces.
The example is noncanonical; no terminality or canonicity claim is made.

scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Minimum weighted degree among well-formed quasismooth six-variable single-loop hypersurfaces with exponents at least two, primitive ambient weights, determinant degree condition, and ample canonical Q-Cartier class. The finite lower-bound search filters only ambient well-formedness, a superset of the target hypersurface class; the witness itself is well-formed.

title: The minimum-degree ample-canonical member of a rational loop-fourfold class
